transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. As we all know, we have a customer class action on the table alleging that account information was exposed through a software vendor's compromised credentials. The complaint seeks damages, injunctive relief, and public disclosure of the incident. We have not yet sent our formal coverage tender or selected litigation counsel. Under our standing claims-committee process, I need to conduct a round-robin review with insurance, claims, client-relations, and conflicts counsel before I can approve the response package. And to be clear, this committee must finalize and approve the response package in this meeting before we adjourn — I will be making the approval decision in-session, not deferring it. So let's work through each function's update. I'd like to start with insurance counsel — what's the status on our coverage position and the carrier documents?
